name: CheckoutPool
rootCause: On 16 March 2026, the legacy CheckoutPool settlement contract on Polygon was exploited due to missing access control on its bridge() function. The attacker crafted a call that allowed funds held for settlement to be redirected to an attacker-owned smart account, resulting in a loss of approximately 85,730 USDC ($85,700). The legacy CheckoutPool contract failed to restrict access to its bridge() function and did not validate that externally-supplied call data matched the intended checkout recipient. This meant anyone could route settlement funds via a crafted bridge call, allowing redirection to arbitrary addresses.
